Complete workflow for pathway enrichment analysis and visualization.

## Workflow

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Define gene sets
gene_sets <- list("T_cell" = c("CD3D", "CD8A"),
                  "B_cell" = c("CD19", "MS4A1"))

# Visualize enrichment
p <- SCpubr::do_EnrichmentHeatmap(sample = sample,
                                  input_gene_list = gene_sets)
p
```
